title: Chromatic Colors
content:
**@gravito/chromatic** is far more than a terminal colorizer. It is the **Universal Aesthetic Spectrum** of the Gravito Galaxy, responsible for maintaining absolute visual consistency across Web, App, and CLI environments.

Beyond CMD: The Aesthetic Protocol

In a complex distributed architecture, visual identity should not just be hardcoded hex values in CSS files. Chromatic elevates "color" to a **communication protocol**, ensuring your brand identity remains precise across every touchpoint.

CLI_INTERFACE

✓ [SYSTEM] Deployment Stable
✗ [WARN] High Latency Detected

Auto-detects ANSI/Truecolor and outputs semantic logs.

WEB_DASHBOARD

SUCCESS
ERROR

Syncs themes to CSS variables for instant site-wide skinning.

Core Application Scenarios

1. Single Source of Truth (SSOT)

Define a semantic color once (e.g., Primary), and Chromatic ensures it is identical in both CLI logs and Web UI.

2. Dynamic UI Calculation

Uses Bun.color() for lightning-fast space conversion, automatically calculating contrast text colors to meet WCAG standards.

3. Backend Graphic Processing

Provides precise interpolation and gradient logic when generating SVGs, QR codes, or Canvas charts on the server.

4. Intelligent Adaptation

The same code outputs CSS for Web, ANSI for local terminals, and monchrome for CI environments automatically.

Visualization: Theme Spectrum

Manage your cross-platform theme matrix with ease:

Semantic TagGlobal SourceWeb Appearance (CSS)CLI Appearance (ANSI)
SUCCESS#10B981--color-successChromatic.green()
WARNING#F59E0B--color-warningChromatic.yellow()
DANGER#EF4444--color-dangerChromatic.red()

Advanced: Dynamic Color Interpolation

Perform fluid color transitions powered by Bun's native kernel, perfect for real-time dashboards:

import { ColorConverter } from '@gravito/chromatic'

// Pick a color between "Healthy" (Green) and "Danger" (Red) based on load
const load = 0.85
const statusColor = ColorConverter.mix('#10B981', '#EF4444', load)

// Apply directly to styles or CLI output
console.log(Chromatic.fg(statusColor)('CRITICAL_LOAD_DETECTED'))

**Bridging Design & Engineering:** Chromatic eliminates the hidden cost of communication. When you say "Primary", it is not just a hex code—it is a visual protocol that spans every runtime environment.
